title: Tokugawa Ieyasu becomes shogun of Japan
summary: Emperor Go-Yozei appointed Tokugawa Ieyasu as shogun, founding the Tokugawa shogunate with its seat at Edo.
reason: Ieyasu's victory at Sekigahara made him the dominant warlord, and the title gave his rule legitimacy.
significance: The Tokugawa shogunate ruled a unified and largely peaceful Japan until 1868.
